$comment: file_map names leaf files only. A failure bundle resolves primitive_key to a file
from here, and pointing one at workflow.py would send every repair at the shell
pre_alert_documentation_arrives maps to mail.py because that is where the event
actually is: the match condition and the correlation key. The workflow only waits.
shipment_validated has no entry. effect=noop with is_terminal, so there is nothing
to send and nothing to build — the workflow records the end state and returns. No
fill targets it, so no failing column can ever resolve to it, and a file would be
somewhere no repair could usefully open.
